object_description: articulated volume with four offset arms
design_condition: Placed at the site head along the surrounding urban geometry, the building extends the park beneath it while creating varied outdoor spaces and separating the sports fields into a distinct complex.

positive.statement: The precision of the implementation and organization of the program is convincing.
The ground floor creates great permeability between the school and the park.
The central void provides a reference space for student orientation and offers work and relaxation spaces.
The building's expression gives it an adequate institutional character.

negative.statement: The single side entrance to the double-height aula is not entirely convincing.
The proposed classroom height raises questions about natural light in the depth of the plan.
The facade principle should have been more modulated for double-height spaces such as the gymnasiums.
Sharing the ground floor between the public park and the school raises questions about the future institution's functioning outside class periods.
